mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: Joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month averages fails to predict positive 20-day returns with Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates tight labor market conditions that accelerate corporate wage pressures and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive year-over-year growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor market activity that supports corporate hiring and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS YoY growth > 0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below its 3-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 3-month moving average over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.5% year-over-year indicates robust supply chain activity that expands corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO YoY > 1.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages signals sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days through elevated earnings visibility.
failure_condition: Joint strength in HOUST and RSAFS above 12-month averages fails to predict positive 60-day returns with Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
